# Coordination request for BioInterfaceOS v0.1.3-r10.29

This is a recruitment/coordination draft. It is not evidence that an external
evaluation, reproduction, adoption or DOI deposit has occurred.

The project is seeking:

- one non-author evaluator who can hold a protected held-out or unseen real
  dataset and return an aggregate lockbox receipt;
- one team with no author participation to reacquire the public PMC6592156
  route and return an accession-to-result reproduction receipt;
- two distinct non-author users or institutions to install the fixed release
  and run different real tasks.

The fixed release and exact commands are in
`docs/external/INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_USER_HANDOFF_R10_29.md`. Do not
post protected row-level data, credentials or private human data in the issue.
Downloads, stars, page views, author-controlled KAUST runs, Codex runs and
GitHub Actions do not count as external evidence.

Until the four hard predicates and an authenticated archive read-back are
verified, `independent_validation`, `external_scientific_reproduction`,
`external_user_adoption`, `doi_archived` and `scientific_submission_ready` stay
`false`.
